basic_details.job_title: Supreme Court Court Master Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 15 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Supreme Court has announced 15 vacancies for the Court Master (Shorthand) post on a deputation basis, requiring applicants to send scanned copies of their applications via email and submit offline applications through the concerned High Court to the Recruitment Cell, Supreme Court of India, Tilak Marg, New Delhi on or before 31 October 2026. The initial engagement is fixed for one year, with a pay scale of Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 - Rs. 2,08,700). Candidates must hold a Degree of a recognized University, have shorthand proficiency of 120 w.p.m., a computer typing speed of 40 w.p.m., and five years

qualification.details: Degree of a recognized University in India. Proficiency in Shorthand with a speed of 120 w.p.m. in Shorthand (English). Knowledge of computer operation with a typing speed of 40 w.p.m. on computer. Holding analogous post on regular basis; or minimum 5 years regular service in the cadre of Private Secretary/Senior PA/PA/Senior Stenographer. Age of the candidate should not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications (1st October, 2026).

selection_process: The selection process comprises a Shorthand Skill Test in English language at the speed of 120 w.p.m. with permissible five per cent mistakes. The maximum marks are 100
and 50 marks are the minimum qualifying marks. Candidates who qualify the Shorthand Skill Test will be subjected to interaction
followed by perusal of ACRs/APARs of the last five years and vigilance clearance.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates working in the High Courts must route and forward their applications through the concerned High Court. Scanned copies must be sent to the e-mail ID [email protected] for early scrutiny. The complete application in the prescribed proforma along with required documents in original must subsequently be sent by post to the following address: Recruitment Cell, Supreme Court of India, Tilak Marg, New Delhi 110001

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for eligible candidates to apply for the post of Court Master (Shorthand) is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age of the candidate should not exceed 56 years as on 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the duration of the deputation period?
faq.answer: The period of deputation is initially fixed as one year, which is extendable to three years, and shall not ordinarily exceed three years in total including service in another ex-cadre post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the email address to send scanned copies of applications?
faq.answer: Scanned copies of applications can be sent to [email protected].
